description: Pinned native damage defaults, Mod built-in damage table, RuleItem damage-pointer identity and classification script helpers. Controlled item copies replace YAML loading; predefined selection and overrides have separate typed/runtime tests. Includes raw float conversions, truncation, half-away armor-percent rounding and defined int-range boundaries; undefined native float-to-int cases are excluded and guarded by the port. Null-profile/state random damage short-circuits use a throwing damage stub and recording RNG; nonnull random computation remains excluded.

buildOptions.sources: RuleDamageType constructor/isDirect; Mod built-in damage table; RuleItem getDamageType/getMeleeType and classification/armor script helpers; exact getDamageToScript template; ScriptBind.h BindSet; getRandomDamageScript short-circuit
buildOptions.compiler: MSVC x64 /std:c++20; method bodies inserted verbatim
